description: This file declares the CPUGeneratorImpl class, which implements a CPU-based random number generator within PyTorch. It includes constructors, sampling methods, and state management functions, along with external functions for generator creation and retrieval.

classes.name: CPUGeneratorImpl
classes.description: Implements a CPU-based pseudorandom number generator, providing seed, offset, state management, and sampling methods within PyTorch.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the generator instance.

methods.name: set_current_seed
methods.description: Sets the current seed value for the generator.

methods.name: set_offset
methods.description: Sets the internal offset or position.

methods.name: current_seed
methods.description: Returns the seed currently in use.

methods.name: seed
methods.description: Returns the primary seed of the generator.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the internal state from a Tensor.

methods.name: get_state
methods.description: Gets the internal state as a Tensor.

methods.name: device_type
methods.description: Returns the device type associated with the generator (likely CPU).

methods.name: next_float_normal_sample
methods.description: Generates a normal distribution sample as a float, optionally.

methods.name: next_double_normal_sample
methods.description: Generates a normal distribution sample as a double, optionally.

methods.name: set_next_float_normal_sample
methods.description: Sets the next float normal sample.

methods.name: set_next_double_normal_sample
methods.description: Sets the next double normal sample.

methods.name: engine
methods.description: Returns the internal Mersenne Twister engine.

methods.name: set_engine
methods.description: Sets the internal Mersenne Twister engine.
